title: Unit 11: Making the News: Passive Voice - Present & Past Simple
objective: Mampu melaporkan perkataan orang lain menggunakan reported speech, memahami perbedaan tenses dalam pelaporan, serta menggunakan verb patterns dengan object + infinitive dalam konteks berita dan jurnalistik.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara melaporkan pernyataan orang lain (reported speech/reported statements) dan penggunaan verb patterns dengan object + infinitive. Ketika kita melaporkan apa yang orang katakan, kita sering mengubah tenses kata kerja: present simple menjadi past simple, present continuous menjadi past continuous, dan seterusnya. Selain itu, beberapa kata kerja seperti ask, want, tell diikuti oleh object (kata benda atau kata ganti) dan infinitive.
rules: Reported Speech - Perubahan Tenses: present simple → past simple (contoh: 'I work hard' → He said that he worked hard), present continuous → past continuous, can → could, will → would
Verb + say/tell: Gunakan 'say' tanpa object, gunakan 'tell' dengan object (contoh: He told me that... / He said that...)

Verb patterns (object + infinitive): Beberapa kata kerja diikuti object + infinitive (contoh: ask, want, tell, persuade, encourage, warn, invite, remind, allow, expect) → 'Mum asked me to tidy my room' atau 'The teacher told him to follow her'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Lupa mengubah tenses atau salah menggunakan tell/say
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah tenses saat melaporkan pernyataan (misalnya tetap menggunakan present simple padahal harus past simple). Kesalahan lain adalah menggunakan 'say' dengan object atau 'tell' tanpa object.
commonTrap.wrong: He said me that he was tired. / She told that she liked it.
commonTrap.correct: He told me that he was tired. / She said that she liked it.

vocab.collocation: April 1st seems to be very popular with journalists.
Swiss farmers were enjoying a really good year for their spaghetti crop.
The BBC later admitted they had made up the whole story.
The athlete had misunderstood the rules of the race.
Edison had invented a food machine that would feed the human race.
We played a joke on him.

dialogue.context: Megan, seorang siswa, sedang kesal membaca berita tentang remaja yang dianggap melakukan vandalisme. Dia berdiskusi dengan teman-temannya Luke, Ryan, dan Olivia tentang berita tersebut.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: What's up, Megan? You don't look too happy.
lines.translation: Ada apa, Megan? Kamu terlihat tidak senang.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: I'm not. Check this out. 'Teenagers in graffiti disgrace - Local teenagers vandalise town centre once again.'
lines.translation: Aku memang tidak senang. Lihat ini. 'Remaja dalam aib grafiti - Remaja lokal vandalisme pusat kota lagi.'

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Do you see that? 'Once again'! Like it happens every day!
lines.translation: Kamu lihat itu? 'Lagi'! Seolah-olah terjadi setiap hari!

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: It makes me so angry when I read headlines like this.
lines.translation: Aku sangat kesal ketika membaca judul berita seperti ini.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Don't get too angry, guys. It's not worth it.
lines.translation: Jangan terlalu marah, teman-teman. Tidak sepadan.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Sorry, Luke, I don't agree. We're talking about this journalist, what's his name, Nigel Forsyth, who doesn't like teenagers.
lines.translation: Maaf, Luke, aku tidak setuju. Kita sedang membicarakan jurnalis ini, siapa namanya, Nigel Forsyth, yang tidak suka remaja.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: That's right. My dad heard him on the radio once, and he was like: Oh, teenagers, all they do is make trouble.
lines.translation: Benar. Ayahku mendengarnya di radio suatu kali, dan dia seperti: Oh, remaja, yang mereka lakukan hanya membuat masalah.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih melaporkan pernyataan dengan Mr. Khoirul. Dia akan memberikan pernyataan langsung, dan Anda harus mengubahnya menjadi reported speech.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's practice reported speech today. I'll give you a direct statement, and you report it using the past tense. Ready? Here's the first one: 'I enjoy reading newspapers.' Now, report what I said.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You said that you enjoyed reading newspapers.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now try this one: 'The students are working on their projects.' How would you report that?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You said that the students were working on their projects.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! One more challenge. Use 'tell' this time: 'Please close the door.' Report what I asked you to do.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You told me to close the door.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! You've got the hang of it. Keep practicing and you'll master reported speech in no time!

quiz.question: Complete the reported speech: 'I can swim very fast.' → He said that he _____ swim very fast.
quiz.explanation: Dalam reported speech, 'can' berubah menjadi 'could' ketika melaporkan pernyataan di masa lampau.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She told that she was tired.
She said me that she was tired.
She told me that she was tired.
quiz.answer: She told me that she was tired.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'tell' harus diikuti oleh object (me, him, her, dll). 'Say' tidak memerlukan object setelahnya.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence with the correct verb pattern: My teacher _____ me _____ my homework.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'ask' diikuti oleh object + infinitive (to + verb). Pola yang benar adalah: asked me to do.

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'We are enjoying the party.' → They said _____.
options: that they are enjoying the party
that they were enjoying the party
quiz.answer: that they were enjoying the party
quiz.explanation: Present continuous 'are enjoying' berubah menjadi past continuous 'were enjoying' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: Which verb pattern is correct?
options: She encouraged me to study harder.
She encouraged to me study harder.
quiz.answer: She encouraged me to study harder.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'encourage' menggunakan pola: object + infinitive (me to study).

quiz.question: Complete: 'I will call you tomorrow.' → He said that he _____ call me the next day.
quiz.explanation: Dalam reported speech, 'will' berubah menjadi 'would' ketika melaporkan pernyataan di masa lampau.
